title: Deeper/broader FreeCAD documentation archive correction and 3D entity-family taxonomy
mode: Primary-source web research and read-only local plan/evidence reconciliation
scope: Correct the FreeCAD documentation repository status recorded in the latest consumer review.
Separate DXF 3DFACE, planar SOLID/TRACE, HATCH, mesh/polyface, and ACIS-backed 3DSOLID/REGION/BODY/SURFACE evidence.
Reconcile the existing FreeCAD 1.1.3 C++ consumer report and optional pinned 3DFACE control without adding a test lane or promoting claims.

sources.project: FreeCAD documentation repository archive status and importer route
sources.revision: Public GitHub repository/page inspected 2026-10-20; mutable main path, repository marked archived on 2026-04-01
sources.observed: The documentation pages remain accessible, but the repository page explicitly marks FreeCAD/FreeCAD-documentation archived/read-only. Its route matrix describes an external DWG-to-DXF converter followed by a selected DXF importer, with separate C++ and legacy Python profiles and stock ACIS/SAT limitations.
sources.limits: Archived documentation is a profile snapshot, not a current runtime contract. No FreeCAD binary or legacy importer was run in this research pass.

sources.observed: 3DFACE uses three/four WCS corners with group-70 invisible-edge flags; planar SOLID uses corner points plus optional thickness and extrusion; 3DSOLID uses a modeler subclass/version, proprietary group-1/3 payload, and a history-object handle. These are distinct geometry/data routes.
sources.limits: Entity wire definitions do not prove any particular library or application preserves, interprets, or constructs the represented geometry.

sources.revision: Mutable main source accessed 2026-10-20; not pinned to a release/runtime
sources.observed: The current C++ importer source contains a generic TopoDS_Shape construction path with a 3DFACE comment, but that downstream generic case alone does not demonstrate that every 3DFACE form reaches it or is accepted.
sources.limits: No source revision, build, or runtime was pinned during this review. Source comments do not supersede the exact application probe.

sources.project: Existing local consumer report and test route
sources.revision: Existing worktree evidence inspected 2026-10-20; prior FreeCAD run identifies 1.1.3 revision 20260725 on macOS arm64 / Qt 6.8.3; not rerun
sources.observed: The prior report compares an existing user-owned AC1021 sample converted by libdxfrw and ODA File Converter 27.1.0.0: both DXFs yielded 4,868 FreeCAD C++ importer objects and reported 38 3DFACE, 69 planar SOLID, and 22 HATCH records unsupported, with entity-read exceptions. The report does not pair every source handle to an imported object. The existing optional macro has a pinned one-tilted-3DFACE unsupported expectation, separate from ordinary 2D and ACIS checks.
sources.limits: Counts alone do not show which remaining records imported, prove per-handle equivalence, or qualify a general FreeCAD 3D route. The external sample remains uncommitted/user-owned; no application, converter, or test was executed in this research pass.

planChanges: Corrected the preceding section: accessible FreeCAD-documentation pages are archived/read-only, not evidence the repository is active.
Added Autodesk-backed distinctions among WCS 3DFACE, planar SOLID/TRACE, HATCH, mesh/polyface, and ACIS-backed 3DSOLID/REGION/BODY/SURFACE.
Reconciled the existing FreeCAD 1.1.3 aggregate unsupported report as downstream route evidence only; required per-identity dispositions for future qualification.
Reused existing local generated 3DFACE controls and optional pinned FreeCAD negative test; added no finding, fixture, CTest, or external per-slice validation requirement.
Kept stock FreeCAD ACIS consumption out of profile and retained all six J items as DEFERRED_EXTERNAL.
limitations: The prior FreeCAD importer result and user-owned AC1021 sample were read from the existing local status record, not rerun or downloaded in this pass.
The FreeCAD application source link is mutable main and was not resolved to an immutable commit.
The local consumer report is aggregate and lacks complete handle-to-imported-object correspondence; it cannot establish equivalence or semantic support.
No Linux or Windows native FreeCAD profile was executed.
